claims: As of April 2026, experts predict a 2.8% Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) for Social Security benefits in 2027.
The 2026 COLA increase matches the predicted 2.8% for 2027.
Senior Citizens League projection predicts a 2.8% increase for 2027 COLA.
The projection raises the average monthly Social Security benefit by about $56.69, from $2,024.77 to $2,081.46.
Some analysts have suggested a 3.2% increase for 2027 COLA due to rising energy costs.
The official 2027 COLA will be based on the CPI-W (Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers) data from the third quarter of 2026 (July, August, and September).
